landing.heroSubtitle: Search clinics by location and calculate distance and travel time in real time. The fastest way to find care near you.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to find the right clinic
landing.locationBody: Enter your address or city and find the nearest clinics. We use geocoding for precise results.
landing.travelBody: Calculate accurate distance and travel time with the Google Maps API. See how long it will take to get there.
landing.filtersBody: Filter clinics by state, search by name, and sort by distance. Find exactly what you need.
landing.detailsBody: See each clinic's address, phone, email, and exact location. Everything in one place.
landing.usersBody: Secure authentication with administrator roles. Admins can manage clinics and users.
landing.fastBody: A Haversine algorithm for very fast distance calculations. Get instant results sorted by proximity.
landing.howSubtitle: Find your clinic in three steps
landing.step1Body: Type your address or city. We geocode it automatically.
landing.step2Body: Filter by state or search by clinic name. Options update in real time.
landing.step3Body: Review clinics sorted by distance, see travel times, and contact them with the details provided.
landing.ctaBody: Start searching and find the care you need
